author: vladimir_ea
content: A question on builder preferences: is it extensible so that arbitrary preferences can be passed, or is it restricted to the 'required' field defined in the spec (here: https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/blob/main/types/gloas/builder_preferences.yaml) ?

author: jtraglia
content: I would assume arbitrary preferences cannot be passed.

author: nflaig
content: technically you could if JSON is used but only if a proxy adds them and the builder can handle them, the `preferences` are not signed over so any mitm can modify them

author: nflaig
content: on the spec side I don't think we should extend them until the next fork, although a v2 could allow to do it earlier

author: jvranek
content:
yea like nico said `preferences` are not signed over, I think the main motivation being so we can just have one new type the VC signs (BuilderRequestAuth) that's used over both submitBuilderPreferences and getExecutionPayloadBid. 

But the auth data bytes are opaque with no specified encoding except an advisory to be the builder's URL. Terence outlined [here](https://terencechain.com/writing/how-epbs-changes-builder-selection/) how the `auth_data` could be used to carry more, so that is the least friction way to to extend. The main requirement is just that the auth data should uniquely identify the propsoer

There was some [discussion in the builder tg chat to make the preferences generic](https://t.me/c/3709773243/212) but didn't make it into a v1.
